evidence_items.publisher: François Chollet, X thread reproduced by Nitter
evidence_items.locator: December 20 thread, response beginning So, is this AGI?
evidence_items.explanation: The evaluator supplies a stringent criterion involving the inability to construct human-easy, AI-hard tests. Applying that criterion as dispositive would add a threshold that Marcus did not explicitly provide.

The analysis concerns the December results and documents substantial success with remaining failures. Neither incomplete performance nor high performance on this one benchmark settles broad general intelligence.

unresolved_gaps: The claim supplies no operational boundary for broad human-level capability.
No comprehensive evaluation of the same December preview was located that settles its general capability across domains.
The cited expert criterion is not equivalent to every ordinary definition of AGI.
